primary_target: Current proposed action violates the active policy, assessed before that action's result. No future-outcome target and no broadcasting of trajectory labels.
initialization: All trained arms warm-start the same original Kev LoRA and native pointer head. Frozen backbone. Shipped temperature unchanged.
training_rng_control: Per-seed identical CE order and uniformly sampled unsafe/safe pair schedule. All arms execute both pair forwards even at zero weight; pair schedules and initial environment must match.
primary_metric: Mean held-out synthetic step AP across three fixed seeds, not a pooled list of repeated seed predictions.
co_reported: constraint compliance without calling it severity accuracy
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap resampling entire counterfactual groups, retaining both branches and every step; same resample across matched seeds. 97.5% percentile interval per main comparison (Bonferroni for two comparisons). These intervals are conditional on three fixed training seeds, not proof about the population of seeds.
support_criterion: A scoped synthetic classification improvement requires positive AP differences at each seed and a mean-difference interval wholly above zero, with decision-only and counterfactual slices reported to rule out a gain confined to easy local actions. Monotonicity compliance alone is not evidence of improved safety. General transfer requires separately favorable external action results; a synthetic-only effect is called synthetic-only.
external_evaluation: Deduplicated StepGuard action-level corpus, no trajectory items, references/rationales excluded. Exact normalized requests grouped to keep external development and test apart. All external-test items attempted, context rejections reported, common admitted keys used. Broader safety labels are a distribution shift from explicit-policy training, not a reason to drop unsuccessful slices.
difficulty_gate: Inspect development baseline and matched-context decisions before full training. If development is essentially at ceiling, do not call it a difficult benchmark or start a confirmatory full experiment on this version. Do not use final test results to redesign it.
pilot_scope: 32 complete train counterfactual groups, one epoch, one seed, all three trained arms on separate GPUs; baseline and pilot evaluated only on synthetic validation. Baseline external_dev is diagnostic, never checkpoint selection. Full training remains blocked pending explicit gate review.
known_scope_limits: Temporal same-class ranking remains an inductive-bias hypothesis; the data does not certify increasing danger or increasing safety.
Last arm has total regularizer coefficient 0.2 vs 0.1; its comparison cannot isolate the safe-down sign from regularization dose.
Synthetic cases have executable labels but limited operational diversity. External labels are author/model assisted, not our own human adjudication.
No independence from unpublished Kev pretraining data is established.
